verdict.rationale: incident.io ships a documented REST API (api.incident.io) with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, webhooks, and status-page/alert endpoints, plus an MCP server that lets AI tools query incidents, alerts, on-call and escalations — a solid but not exhaustive API surface. However, the evidence explicitly admits the Terraform/infra-as-code provider is still being built 'resource by resource,' implying API/IaC parity with the UI is incomplete, and there is no explicit claim or independent confirmation that literally every UI action (e.g., insights/analytics configuration, schedule building UI features) is exposed via the API. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, confirmed OpenAPI spec location (probe found the guessed paths 404), and evidence covering less-common UI features like insights toggles or schedule creation via API.
